data_fields.name: opponent_beat_delay
data_fields.donor_constant: 1000 ms before an uncommented opponent move plays

data_fields.name: first_opponent_beat_delay
data_fields.donor_constant: 300 ms when the chapter opens with the opponent's move

data_fields.name: wrong_input_takeback_delay
data_fields.donor_constant: 800 ms before an uncommented wrong move is taken back

data_fields.name: beat_pause_mode
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: a beat with a caption pending waits for the player's tap (no timeout)

data_fields.name: deviation_index
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: wrong move's comment at index ply + 1 (a move is indexed by the ply it produces)

best_idea: A scripted sequence where each beat auto-advances after a delay unless a caption is pending, a wrong input is shown then taken back by timer unless the author wrote a caption for it, and the record keeps the fewest inputs.
decision_why: Keep the pause-for-read gate, the timed take-back of a wrong input and the fewest-count record; put the delays on each beat in zone data, and make the pause non-blocking in combat, because the donor's infinite wait on a caption would freeze a fight. Any reward tied to completion must be checked on the server.
acceptance: In a tutorial fight the enemy's scripted reply plays 1 s after the player's input unless that beat has a caption; a wrong input is shown and taken back after 0.8 s unless the author wrote a caption for it; the completion record keeps the fewest inputs and is verified on the server.
